use.flag: Route ALSA playback to PipeWire (requires media-video/pipewire with USE=pipewire-alsa)

pkgmetadata.longdescription: SoundCraft is a clean-room reimplementation of a Pro Tools-style digital audio workstation in pure Rust: record, edit and mix audio, drawn on the GPU (wgpu). Installed from the upstream Linux tarball; the binary only links against glibc and ALSA and loads the graphics libraries at runtime. Early alpha.
